name: Gunship
notes: A heavy gunship: a bow gun firing a shell an order of magnitude heavier than the corvette's, and a broadside turret on each beam for anything that gets inside it. Twice the corvette's engines move four times its mass, so it is markedly more sluggish — which is the point of having two ships to compare.

outrigger.notes: An outrigger, holding a small fast-firing multi-barrelled gun clear of the spine. A gun flat against the hull has almost no traverse worth the mass it costs.

modules.notes: Many narrow barrels rather than one wide one: the same bore budget spent on rate of fire instead of weight of shell.

mainEngine.notes: One of the pair that drives the ship forward.

wingBox.notes: A stub holding a manoeuvring thruster out where its moment arm is worth having.

lateral.notes: A manoeuvring thruster pushing inboard, so its exhaust leaves into clear air rather than into the stub it is bolted to.
